name: Tortoise
description: Per-turn volunteering-memory injection and session capture for Tortoise (epic #2080, #2120).

apiUrl.description: Tortoise API base URL used by the hosted reflex (POST /v1/context).

apiKey.description: Tortoise API key for the hosted reflex and for capture.

command.description: Local `tortoise` executable to run the reflex through instead of the hosted API.

timeoutMs.description: Per-turn reflex budget in milliseconds. The reflex is fail-open: on timeout nothing is injected.

capture.description: Append each turn to the local capture spool read by `tortoise sessions import --harness openclaw`.
